environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Apache Tomcat 8.5.41 with the legacy monolith WAR deployed directly. Instance is in a public subnet with an ALB forwarding traffic on port 443 to port 8080. No request body inspection is configured on the ALB. The classpath includes commons-collections 3.2.1, spring-beans 4.3.18, and other gadget-chain-capable libraries. JDK 8u181 without JEP-290 serialization filters. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
